notes.title: Flying Soul Update Pack 1
notes.notes:
Since the launch of the game on Steam Several small updates added to the first update pack of the game.
Here is the list of improvements made:
[list]
    [*]Restart Level pressing button X
    [*]Tutorial Level restructured
    [*]White Squares angle are now 45º
    [*]Bug that happened when the player finished the squares and the time was up, but the game over did not happen.
    [*]The Squares color was changed smooth
    [*]Time rebalanced
    [*]Block size changed to improve the gameplay
    [*]Box Life green added
[/list]

Thanks for playing!
More news are coming!
